def solve(chain):
    tokens = chain[0]
    remaining = chain[1:]
    remaining_set = set(remaining)
    remaining_set.discard(tokens)
    
    while remaining_set:
        next_token = remaining_set.pop()
        remaining.remove(next_token)
        remaining_set.add(next_token)
    
    return ','.join(remaining)
```
